title: Solve the camera from landmarks (with roll), then trust the solve
summary: Measure 15-20 landmarks on a 1920x1080 grid, solve position, look, fov, ROLL (and shift) plus free dimensions with soft priors. Never hand-tweak the solved camera: re-fit the scene instead.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: Solver residuals: dig 48 m block at 42 px rms without roll -> 16 px with roll; café 27 px rms once interior landmarks were added.

doc.avoid: Eyeballing the camera; moving it by hand after the solve.
gotchas: Shell-only landmarks can put interior objects outside the room (the café bar landed 6 m deep): add interior landmarks.
A hand-tweaked café camera drifted ~100 px and made the room too wide; returning to the solve lined the edges up again.

problem.symptom: The first solve fits badly (42 px rms, a 48 m block) or a tweaked camera drifts ~100 px from the reference edges.
problem.cause: No roll in the camera model (the reference's verticals lean both ways), too few interior landmarks, or manual camera edits after the solve.
problem.fix: Add roll (and lens shift) as free parameters, landmarks inside the space too, soft priors on depths; keep the solved camera and move/scale objects to fit.
problem.detect: Weighted rms > ~25 px; the edge overlay shows systematic drift across the frame.
